# Alley

`alley_game.glb` is the gameplay environment. `alley_game_low.glb` is the same scene with smaller textures for older phones.

TurboSquid Standard licence, purchased by IQ Apps Group, not redistributable.

The files ship inside the app and the web build. They are not part of the hillside or beach kits, and they are not offered as a mod pack or a separate download. Do not copy them into `public/models/environment/` or `public/models/beach/`.
